content_sections.heading: RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: RCF Ltd has notified 10 vacancies for the Assistant Officer (Secretarial) EO Grade post under post code EOASSTSEC/072026. The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease at RCF's discretion. Note: The number of vacancies (#) is tentative and may be cancelled, restricted, enlarged, modified or altered by RCF Ltd without further notice, as per Presidential Directives on reservation.

content_sections.heading: RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: RCF Assistant Officer eligibility is based on a specific educational qualification combined with post-qualification secretarial experience. There are two alternative qualification routes, and candidates should check both carefully before applying. Route A: Three years regular and full-time Graduate in any discipline from a UGC/AICTE recognised university, AND two years regular and full-time Post Graduate in any discipline from a UGC/AICTE recognised university, AND a 1-year Government-recognised Diploma in Executive Assistant/Executive Personal Assistant/Office Management and Secretarial Practice/Modern Office Management/Stenography course or equivalent. Route B: Three years regular and full-time Bachelor's degree/B.Voc/BA(VS)/B(Voc) specifically in Office Management and Secretarial Practice, Office Administration and Secretarial Practices, or Management & Secretarial Practices, AND regular and full-time Post Graduate in any discipline from a UGC/AICTE recognised university. Desired skills mentioned in the notification: knowledge of Shorthand, strong communication and drafting skills, ability to handle confidential documents, proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), and good computer typing speed and accuracy.

rows.details: 55% marks in final year of Graduation (50% for SC candidates)

Minimum 4 years of relevant work experience (after Graduation) as Secretarial Assistant/Secretary or similar roles, as on 01.07.2026. Training, apprentice training and internship periods are not counted.
A comprehensive experience summary on the organisation's official letterhead must be uploaded; it is a mandatory pre-requisite for eligibility
Candidates in the final year of Graduation/Post-Graduation are NOT eligible to apply
No consequential benefit is given for possessing a higher qualification than prescribed; no equivalence claim is entertained

content_sections.heading: RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Age Limit
content_sections.text: The RCF Assistant Officer age limit is calculated as on the cut-off date of 01.07.2026, and this cut-off will remain unchanged irrespective of any reason. Additional age relaxations as per the notification: 5 years for SC and 3 years for OBC (NCL) candidates against reserved posts; 10 years for UR/EWS PwBD, 15 years for SC PwBD, and 13 years for OBC (NCL) PwBD candidates against reserved posts; 5 years for Departmental candidates; and 5 years additional concession for children/family members of victims of the 1984 riots.

faq.question: Q1. What is RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd) to fill 10 vacancies for the post of Assistant Officer (Secretarial), EO Grade, under Advertisement No. 01072026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies are notified: 6 UR, 1 SC, 2 OBC (NCL), 1 EWS, including 1 PwBD (OH-OL) horizontal vacancy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration is 26 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate plus Post Graduate degree with a 1-year Diploma in Secretarial Practice (Route A), or a specific Bachelor's degree in Office Management/Secretarial Practice plus a Post Graduate degree (Route B), along with a minimum of 4 years of post-qualification secretarial work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit as on 01.07.2026 is 32 years for UR/EWS, 37 years for SC, and 35 years for OBC (NCL), with additional relaxation for PwBD and other eligible categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General, OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates must pay Rs. 1,000/- plus bank charges and GST. SC, ST, PwBD, Female, Departmental and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only, through www.rcfltd.com, by completing registration, uploading the required documents, paying the applicable fee, and submitting the form before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial)?
faq.answer: Selection is through a computer-based Online Test (100 questions, 90 minutes, with negative marking) followed by a qualifying Skill Test worth 100 marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial), EO Grade?
faq.answer: The EO Grade pay scale is Rs. 30,000 - Rs. 120,000, with an approximate minimum gross monthly salary of Rs. 65,000, plus company accommodation, PRP, medical facility, gratuity, CPF, and other benefits.
